status: PROVISIONAL. Written 2026-10-06 BEFORE any physical camera frame was analysed. Change only by commit with a stated reason, never after looking at which camera a change would favour. Every report records the sha256 of this file.

envelope.why: A working distance counts when the centre-placed reference square's median 10-90% edge rise is <= edge_rise_px_max and the edge/corner-placed one is <= edge_rise_px_max x edge_placement_factor. Pixels of the analysed frame (expected 1640x1232 raw). Starting value only: re-derive once the B0394 at its set focus shows what 'sharp' is on this pipeline.

reference.why: commonly achieved ChArUco RMS for a well-behaved lens at this resolution
enough poses to constrain 9 intrinsic parameters
corners must reach the outer image so distortion is measured, not extrapolated
stability needs two calibrations from distinct physical mountings (mount_id); A + A does not count
intrinsics must survive remount/refocus discipline within 1%
after undistortion, edge lines straight to sub-pixel
edge geometry no worse than 2x centre after calibration
useful over more than one bench distance
1% relative spread of the Scout length measurement, unmoved scene
spread estimated from at least 8 accepted frames
every quantitative frame needs a reproducibly known focus state: fixed, manual_locked, or a recorded motor position. not_exposed is INSUFFICIENT, not a pass
